title: CLAUDE.md
text: repo uses cairn plugin. project state lives markdown cairn/. Boundary rule: Architecture → DESIGN · Status → ROADMAP · Tasks → milestone files · Decisions → DECISIONS · History → archive + git. Start /milestone — status snapshot, health audit, suggested next action. Never record status TODOs file; anything time-varying rots . Work tiers: trivial edits (runtime surface) commit directly main; user-visible bugs go /hotfix; everything else milestone (/milestone-plan → /milestone-implement → /milestone-review). Ideas: “add X candidates” appends ROADMAP row — ceremony. Nothing merges main without user’s explicit approval review. Claude’s persistent memory never holds project state; cairn/ files win conflict. skills read plugin’s skills/shared/tracking-rules.md first obey .

title: Open Affective Computing Tools
text: openac provides R wrappers around external, open-source affective-computing tools — ffmpeg/ffprobe, OpenFace, openSMILE, Whisper (via audio.whisper) — researchers can run single, consistent R interface. covers tool discovery, installation, configuration; audio/video preparation; single-file batch extraction (parallelism progress); reading tool’s output tidy tibble.

text: openac tidymedia wrap ffmpeg/ffprobe, export eight names: ffm, ffmpeg, ffprobe, find_ffmpeg, find_ffprobe, set_ffmpeg, set_ffprobe, set_program Attaching packages masks one set , decided attach order, warning beyond R’s masking message. Six eight behave differently packages, masked call can succeed wrong thing: ffm sharpest. openac alias ffmpeg() returns tool’s output. tidymedia constructs command object runs nothing. find_* set_* pairs read write different configuration directories. tool location recorded openac::set_ffmpeg() invisible tidymedia::find_ffmpeg(), reverse. Register tool package use . set_program() accepts different program names package. need , qualify calls — openac::ffmpeg(), tidymedia::ffm() — rather relying attach order. title: openac 0.1.0
text: First public release. openac wraps open-source affective-computing tools — ffmpeg/ffprobe, OpenFace, openSMILE, Whisper (via audio.whisper) — behind one consistent R interface: tool discovery/installation, audio/video preparation, single-file batch (_dir) extraction parallelism (future/furrr) progress (progressr), tidy readers tool outputs. Reading tool outputs tidy tibbles: os_read() reads openSMILE CSV output — either aggregate (functionals) file per-frame low-level descriptor (LLD) file — tidy tibble, auto-detecting delimiter preserving openSMILE’s feature names. of_read() reads OpenFace output CSV tidy tibble (one row per detected face per frame), trimming whitespace OpenFace pads column headers . aw_read() turns Whisper transcription — object aw_transcribe(), .rds/.csv output — tidy tibble one row per segment, parsing HH:MM:SS.mmm timestamps numeric seconds keeping speaker column diarized transcripts.
